name: Leraje
source:
One of the 72 pillars of Solomon nicknamed "Chaotic Hunter", his many arms wield crossbows and other weapons which unleash blows which fester on his unfortunate victims.

Despite his appearance, he is respectful to those who resist his aura face-to-face and is not fond of indiscriminate and meaningless killing.
